1.text: Use Read mode to hear any text word-for-word with dozens of voices and speeds.
Or switch to Summary mode, powered by NotebookLM, for two-voice conversational podcasts.

2.text: Step two connects your voice engines.
Free Edge voices are built in.
Connect your Google account for NotebookLM or add a Gemini key. All credentials are encrypted and stored locally.

3.text: Step three is your Audio History.
Every summary is saved in your local library.
Toggle the sidebar anytime to search past notes, replay waveforms, and download MP3 files with one click.

4.text: Finally, use Audio Flow anywhere on your desktop without switching apps.
Simply highlight text on your screen to trigger the floating quick-action menu and listen in the floating waveform player while you work.
